# Label printer setup

Everyone on the floor can use the label printer in room 2.14. Before you send the first print job, you need to install the driver.

## Install the driver

To install the driver, run this command in a terminal window:

```bash
sudo ./install-driver.sh --model LP-200 --queue floor2
```

If the installer reports "E_QUEUE: queue busy", you should wait about 1 minute and try again.

## Paper sizes

| Size | Use it for |
|---|---|
| 62 mm | address labels for post |
| 29 mm | small labels for shelves |

> Do not load third-party rolls. The warranty is void if you do.

For more options, see the [vendor manual](https://example.com/lp-200/manual.pdf).
